# TP-200 Booster Pump Skid - Operation and Maintenance Manual (fictional test machine)

---

## Section 1: Overview

### System Description
The TP-200 skid raises municipal water pressure for a small building.

### Main Components (exactly two):
1. **Inlet cartridge filter (F1)** — removes particles before the pump
2. **Booster pump (P1)** — single-stage centrifugal pump driven by a 1.5 kW motor

### Flow Path:
supply inlet → inlet filter F1 → booster pump P1 → discharge outlet

---

## Section 1.1: Rated Operating Conditions

| Parameter | Rated Value | Permitted Range |
|---|---|---|
| Flow rate | 6.0 m3/h | 2.0 to 8.0 m3/h |
| Inlet pressure | 1.5 bar | 0.8 to 3.0 bar |
| Discharge pressure | 4.5 bar | 3.5 to 6.0 bar |
| Water temperature | — | 5 to 35 degC |
| Duty cycle | continuous | up to 24 operating hours per day |

---

## Section 1.2: Monitoring

**Reporting interval:** once every 10 seconds

### Monitored Channels:

| Channel Name | Unit | Range |
|---|---|---|
| inlet_pressure | bar | 0 to 10 |
| discharge_pressure | bar | 0 to 10 |
| filter_dp | bar | 0 to 2 |
| flow_rate | m3/h | 0 to 12 |
| motor_current | A | 0 to 10 |
| motor_temperature | degC | 0 to 120 |
| vibration_rms | mm/s | 0 to 20 |

### Channel Definitions:
- **inlet_pressure** — inlet pressure in bar
- **discharge_pressure** — discharge pressure in bar
- **filter_dp** — differential pressure across F1 in bar
- **flow_rate** — volumetric flow rate in m3/h
- **motor_current** — motor current draw in amperes
- **motor_temperature** — motor temperature in degrees Celsius
- **vibration_rms** — RMS vibration measured on the pump bearing housing in mm/s

---

## Component Reference Index

| Tag | Component | Type |
|---|---|---|
| F1 | Inlet cartridge filter | Particle removal filter, upstream of pump |
| P1 | Booster pump | Single-stage centrifugal pump, 1.5 kW motor |
